newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria announces official referendum result.
newsitem.headline: Algeria announces official referendum result.

text.p: Official results from Algeria's referendum to change the country's constitution showed that 84.60 percent voted 'yes' for change and 15.40 voted 'no', the Constitutional Council announced.
Council president Said Bouchair, in a statement carried by the official news agency APS late on Sunday, said the turnout had been revised downwards because of a delay in returns from one region.
